What to check

Before booking installation, review these 3 quick checks to ensure perfect door and lock compatibility:

01

Decide where you need to answer the door

Compare the indoor screen position and size for viewing from home. If you also need to answer while away, check remote talk and remote unlock on the individual model.

02

Test Wi-Fi with the doors shut

Check your home Wi-Fi on a phone beside the lock position. Repeat with the door and any outer grille shut to see how the connection behaves during normal use.

03

Check the camera view at the usual standing point

Take a photo from where a visitor presses the bell. Ask the installer whether grille bars, the frame or a narrow corridor will block the view.
